theme: Dark Gaming Aesthetic with Kinetic Micro-Interactions

core_principles: Tactical Precision & High Density: Technical grid, clipped chamfer corners, laser-cyan accents
Cinematic Storytelling: Parallax character heroes, kinetic masked text reveals, noise textures
Instant Signal Feedback: Real-time status indicators (Undetected, Updating, Detected) with pulsing glowing beacons
Zero-Friction Conversion: Direct duration selector on product cards, quick cart drawer slide-out, instant guest checkout flow
anti_patterns: No rounded corporate SaaS shapes; use clipped chamfer corners or subtle 4px/6px radius with crisp 1px borders
No generic blue gradients; use pure obsidian black (#06070B), deep void navy (#0B0E17), and electric icy cyan (#00F0FF) glow
No plain white body background; maintain moody dark ambient backdrop with grainy SVG overlay

font_family_pairings.headings: Cabinet Grotesk / Unbounded / Outfit (Sans Display, bold uppercase, letter-spacing -0.03em)
font_family_pairings.body: Outfit / Inter (Clean geometric sans for descriptions and options)
font_family_pairings.mono_readouts: JetBrains Mono / Space Mono (For status badges, price tags, license keys, ping rates, technical specs)

scale_hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight
scale_hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-extrabold uppercase tracking-tight

layout_and_grid.hero_layout: Full viewport height relative hero with layered background parallax grid, masked line reveal text, floating status HUD badge, and dual CTA
layout_and_grid.product_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 sm:gap-8

surface_and_styling.tactical_card: bg-[#0F1422] border border-cyan-900/40 hover:border-cyan-400/60 transition-all duration-300 rounded-lg overflow-hidden group relative
surface_and_styling.spotlight_effect: Radial cyan gradient following cursor hover on product cards
surface_and_styling.noise_overlay: repeating-linear-gradient or SVG grain texture layer at 3% opacity across body background

storefront_home.hero_section: Cinematic banner with FiveM / GTA / Shooter character art, kinetic masked headline reveal 'UNDETECTED. UNMATCHED.', live server ping counter, quick jump to games
storefront_home.game_filter_tabs: Categories: All Games, FiveM / GTA, Rust, COD Warzone, Valorant, Apex Legends, Fortnite
storefront_home.product_cards: Displays game cover artwork, status pill (UNDETECTED / UPDATING), feature highlights tags (Aimbot, ESP, HWID Spoofer), 'From €X.XX' price tag, quick direct 'Buy Now' trigger to direct modal or drawer
storefront_home.reviews_marquee: Infinite smooth scrolling ticker with verified buyer reviews, rating stars, and customer quotes
storefront_home.status_banner: Live security & system health counter (e.g., 99.8% Uptime, Last HWID Spoofer test 5 mins ago)
storefront_home.faq_accordion: Interactive FAQ addressing safety, injection guides, HWID spoofing, instant key delivery

product_detail_modal.duration_selector: 1 Day (€4.99) / 1 Week (€19.99) / 1 Month (€39.99) / Lifetime (€89.99) option cards with active glow state
product_detail_modal.features_list: Bullet list of features (Aimbot, Silent Aim, ESP, Skeleton, No Recoil, Radar, Config Saver)
product_detail_modal.system_requirements: OS compatibility (Win 10/11), Processor (Intel/AMD), Anti-cheat target (EAC, BE, FiveM Guard)
product_detail_modal.action_buttons: Add to Cart (drawer open) & Instant Checkout button

cart_drawer.slide_out_drawer: Right slide-out modal, selected items, subtotal calculation, discount coupon field, guest email input, direct Stripe / Crypto checkout trigger

checkout_and_confirmation.guest_checkout: Fast guest email field with instant Stripe test payment trigger
checkout_and_confirmation.order_confirmation_modal: Displays generated order ID, license key formatted like 'VOID-8829-X7K9-994A', copy-to-clipboard button, download injector link, step-by-step setup guide
checkout_and_confirmation.order_lookup_page: Search past orders by email to re-retrieve license keys

status_page.cheat_status_matrix: Full list of all game products, current anti-cheat status (Undetected green dot, Updating yellow dot, Testing blue dot), last updated timestamp, anti-cheat target details

admin_dashboard.authentication: Admin login modal / view with key phrase or password
admin_dashboard.product_management: CRUD operations for products (Add product, change status Undetected/Updating/Detected, edit pricing options, update stock counts)
admin_dashboard.license_key_inventory: Manage license key stock pools per duration
admin_dashboard.orders_list: View recent orders, filter by customer email, view issued keys

micro_interactions: Spotlight cursor tracker on card mouse move
Pulsing status indicator dot (pinging glow effect)
Copy license key button with instant success checkmark and toast notification
Infinite ticker ribbon for customer reviews
Staggered entrance reveal for product cards on scroll

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Always read design_guidelines.json carefully before constructing or updating components.
2. Ensure all components use dark background (#06070B or #0B0E17) with electric cyan glow highlights (#00F0FF).
3. Implement full e-commerce flow: Home store -> Product Modal (1d/1w/1m) -> Cart Drawer -> Stripe/Guest Checkout -> Order Confirmation with License Key.
4. Ensure key pages (Status Page, Order Lookup, Admin Dashboard) are easily navigable via header/footer or URL routing/modal.
5. Use sonner for toast notifications when adding items to cart or copying license keys.
6. Include data-testid on all interactive elements as described in data_testid_conventions.
